[TASK_TYPE=design]
[BOUNDARY=crypto]
[SEVERITY=major]
privAI needs a final authorization digest for escrow spends. Should the design bind only outputs and fee, or the full concrete transaction body?
Bind the full concrete transaction body. Restricting the digest to outputs and fee weakens substitution resistance and leaves too much of the spend semantics outside the signed preimage.

[TASK_TYPE=explore]
[BOUNDARY=crypto+proof]
[SEVERITY=major]
If privAI already verifies each statement commit per transaction, why add a separate batch public-input root at all?
Because per-transaction checks do not fully bind the batch as one proof object. A separate batch root ties the certificate to the exact public-input collection used for the whole execution bundle.

[TASK_TYPE=design]
[BOUNDARY=crypto+ledger]
[SEVERITY=major]
privAI wants replay protection to survive future signature-scheme swaps. What should remain protocol-invariant?

The protocol must keep replay resistance tied to the signed message definition and state bindings, not to the signature family itself. Fresh nullifiers, transaction-bound digests, and policy-bound signer identity should remain invariant.
